records.source: Rosprirodnadzor 2026-10-02; appellate case re LLC Energetik; damage >19.6m RUB
records.pattern: sewer infrastructure -> wastewater escape -> soil -> migration -> water body -> evidence -> damage
records.risk: single incident can create soil and water damage contours

records.contour: mining -> auxiliary domestic wastewater -> septic tank -> terrain -> soil
records.source: Rosprirodnadzor 2026-10-01; Kaa-Khem deposit; soil damage 3,426,508 RUB
records.npa: Order Minprirody Russia 08.07.2010 No.238, as amended
records.pattern: mining site -> domestic wastewater -> septic/storage -> capacity/tightness -> pumping -> actual route -> overflow/discharge -> soil -> evidence -> damage
records.risk: auxiliary sanitation infrastructure can independently create material soil-damage liability
records.mirlex_check: sanitary infrastructure; people/water use; wastewater volume; septic capacity/tightness; pumping frequency; hauled volume; carrier; receiver; balance; overflow route
records.red_flag: septic exists but wastewater balance and final receipt cannot be proven, or overflow reaches terrain

records.pattern: I/II/III category + stationary sources -> NMU applicability -> current agreed plan -> forecast -> NMU degree -> emission-reduction measures -> execution evidence
records.risk: legacy NMU plan may not satisfy rules effective 01.03.2026
records.mirlex_check: category; stationary sources; plan date/legal basis; approval; forecast source; measures; operational launch; reduction substantiation; logs/notices
records.red_flag: old NMU plan after 01.03.2026 or no proof of forecast receipt/execution

records.contour: oil & gas -> APG -> flare/dispersion -> air -> environmental fee
records.npa: Government Resolution No.710 of 22.05.2025 as amended by No.1221 of 23.09.2026
records.pattern: APG produced -> burned/dispersed -> actual share -> period threshold -> exceptions -> coefficient 25 if applicable -> environmental fee
records.risk: errors in produced/burned APG volumes or threshold/exceptions can change fee materially; 2026 temporal application requires separate legal-practice check
records.mirlex_check: APG production; burned/dispersed volume; primary accounting; percentage; annual threshold; exceptions; K=25; declaration/payment reconciliation
records.red_flag: APG is burned/dispersed but no traceable produced -> burned -> % -> threshold -> exception/K=25 -> fee calculation
